identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of an Investigational Medication for the Treatment of Secondary Hyperparathyroidism in Dialysis Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of an Oral Calcimimetic Agent (AMG 073) in Secondary Hyperparathyroidism of End Stage Renal Disease Treated With Hemodialysis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This 6 month long study will assess an investigational medication for patients on dialysis with secondary hyperparathyroidism. The study will look at the effects on parathyroid hormone, calcium and phosphorus levels.

interventions.name: AMG 073
interventions.description: 30 mg QD orally 60 mg QD orally 90 mg QD orally 120 mg QD orally 180 mg QD orally

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: 30 mg QD orally 60 mg QD orally 90 mg QD orally 120 mg QD orally 180 mg QD orally

primaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the efficacy of AMG 073 compared with placebo by determining the proportion of subjects with a mean intact parathyroid hormone (iPTH) value <= 250 pg/mL (26.5 pmol/L) during the efficacy assessment phase.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: efficacy assessment phase (last 14 weeks of treatment)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the efficacy of AMG 073 compared with placebo by determining: percentage change from baseline in mean calcium x phosphorus product (Ca x P) during the efficacy assessment phase
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: efficacy assessment phase (last 14 weeks of treatment)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the efficacy of AMG 073 compared with placebo by determining: changes in self-reported cognitive function from baseline to the end of the efficacy assessment phase
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: efficacy assessment phase (last 14 weeks of treatment)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the safety of AMG 073 compared with placebo.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: * Patients must be receiving hemodialysis; \* Have elevated parathyroid hormone levels; \* Not be pregnant or nursing; and \* Not have had a heart attack in the last 3 months.
